units.source_text: 到了约定的日子，薰大将派一个心腹的下仆，

en.t: When the appointed day arrived, General Kaoru sent a trusted servant,

units.source_text: 陪着一个素不相识的放牛人，驱车到宇治去迎接弁君。

en.t: together with an unfamiliar ox driver, to take a carriage to Uji and bring Lady Ben back.

units.source_text: 他对下仆说：“到庄园里去挑选一个老实的人，叫他当警卫。”

en.t: He told the servant, "Go to the estate, choose an honest man, and have him serve as a guard."

units.source_text: 他前天早已和弁君约定，叫她必须进京，故弁君虽然很不乐意，也只得打扮一下，乘车出发。

en.t: Two days earlier he had already arranged with Lady Ben that she must come to the capital, so although she was very unwilling, she had no choice but to dress herself and set out by carriage.

units.source_text: 她看到山野的景色，想起古来种种诗歌，不胜感慨。

en.t: Seeing the scenery of the hills and fields, she recalled many poems from ancient times and was overcome with feeling.

units.source_text: 不久车子来到了浮舟所居的三条宅院。

en.t: Before long the carriage arrived at the Sanjo residence where Ukifune was living.

units.source_text: 这地方非常冷僻，不见人影。

en.t: The place was extremely secluded, with not a person in sight.

units.source_text: 弁君很放心，叫车子进入院内，命引路人传言：“弁君奉薰大将之命前来叩访。”

en.t: Lady Ben felt reassured, had the carriage enter the grounds, and told the guide to announce, "Lady Ben has come to call by order of General Kaoru."

units.source_text: 便有一个以前伴赴初濑进香的青年侍女出来迎接，扶弁君下车。

en.t: Then a young maid who had once accompanied them on a pilgrimage to Hatsuse came out to receive her and helped Lady Ben down from the carriage.

units.source_text: 浮舟住在这荒凉的屋子里，晨夕愁叹，不胜寂寞。

en.t: Ukifune lived in this desolate house, sighing morning and evening, unable to bear the loneliness.

units.source_text: 闻得这个可与话旧的人来了，喜不自胜，立刻唤她到自己房中相见。

en.t: When she heard that someone had come with whom she could speak of the past, she was overjoyed and immediately called her into her own room.

units.source_text: 她想起这人所服侍过的人是我的父亲，便觉异常可亲。

en.t: Remembering that the person this woman had once served was her own father, she felt an extraordinary closeness to her.

units.source_text: 弁君对她说道：“自从那天拜见小姐之后，私心仰慕，无时或忘。

en.t: Lady Ben said to her, "Ever since the day I met you, my lady, I have admired you in my heart and have never forgotten you for a moment.

units.source_text: 但老身早已出家为尼，与世长遗，故二条院二小姐处亦不曾前去拜访。

en.t: But I had long since left the world and become a nun, living apart from worldly affairs, and so I did not even go to visit the second young lady at Nijo-in.

units.source_text: 惟此次薰大将再三嘱托，异常热心，因此只得勉强遵命，前来奉扰。”

en.t: Only this time General Kaoru urged me again and again with such earnestness that I had no choice but to obey reluctantly and come to trouble you."

units.source_text: 浮舟和乳母前日曾在二条院窥见薰大将丰采，不胜赞美。

en.t: The other day Ukifune and her nurse had glimpsed General Kaoru's splendid appearance at Nijo-in and had praised him without end.

units.source_text: 又曾听他说过时刻不忘浮舟，更深感激。

en.t: They had also heard that he said he never forgot Ukifune for a moment, which moved them even more deeply.

units.source_text: 却想不到如此突然地派人来访。

en.t: Yet they had never imagined that he would send someone to visit so suddenly.
